parameters.name: filter[status]
parameters.description: Optional. One of: open, overdue, due_7d, paid, all. Defaults to open.

parameters.name: filter[doc_type]
parameters.description: Optional. Restrict to a single document type: purchase_invoice or bill.

parameters.name: filter[search]
parameters.description: Optional. Free-text search across document / supplier-invoice numbers (max 255 chars).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Optional. One of: due_date, -due_date, date, -date, total, -total, outstanding_balance, -outstanding_balance. Defaults to due_date.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page (min 1, max 100). Defaults to 10.
